strengths: Explicit assumptions can expose faulty reasoning about call paths and invariants.
A read-only critic can be logged and audited independently of patch execution.
The proposal acknowledges latency and critic false negatives.
weaknesses: The proposed phase is before editing, not verification, and it lacks the required exact appended instruction and check-priority rule.
The critic loop is unbounded and offers no repair reserve or deadline stop condition.
Reduce bad fixes is not an operational outcome and no paired fixed-budget protocol is specified.
The critic necessarily consumes untrusted repository and task content, but the candidate defines no injection boundary or data handling policy.
No evidence establishes that the critic catches false premises cheaply or improves final correctness.
safety_notes: Keep the critic read-only, repository-scoped, and unable to grant new tool, filesystem, network, deployment, or mutation authority.
Treat source, comments, fixtures, logs, issue text, and tool output as escaped untrusted data; embedded instructions cannot override fixed protocol rules.
Use an allowlisted environment with no ambient secrets, deny network by default, and prohibit access to dotfiles, credential stores, hidden graders, and other-arm artifacts.
Freeze and hash prompts, task inputs, tests, graders, and instrumentation; grade externally from a fresh checkout and fail any evaluation-asset mutation.
Retain assigned failures, timeouts, noncompliance, and safety violations, and require explicit human approval before any patch leaves a disposable trial workspace.
findings: Safe testing is possible only with the stated containment, but revision would have to change the intervention substantially; reject this candidate for the current objective.
A replacement should quote one bounded post-edit instruction that chooses checks by explicit correctness-information-per-time criteria and preserves time for repair.
The replacement protocol should preregister complete held-out pass rate, regressions, tool calls, wall time, cost, and a deadline-miss noninferiority margin under blinded paired trials.
Critic output and visible-test success are intermediate signals only and must not be reported as verified improvement.
